how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-loch-modan-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:278:obj:0: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to gather ⟦E1⟧, a ⟦E2⟧, and a ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:278:details:0: Begin collecting the disarming materials immediately, ⟦1⟧. ⟦E1⟧ can be found on the indigenous spiders in ⟦E4⟧. Crocolisk tears are found here in the Loch as well. But a Mo'Grosh crystal will be very difficult to procure. The ogres to the northeast mine them but the crystals are a very rare commodity.
rows.quest:278:details:1: We need to be prepared to defuse a Dark Iron attack! Return to me once you've collected the needed items and I will prepare the mixture.
rows.quest:278:progress:0: Do you have the needed items? Time is of the essence!!
rows.quest:280:obj:0: Chief Engineer Hinderweir wants you to swim down to the base of the dam, locate the powder keg and stir in the ⟦E5⟧ to prevent an explosion.
rows.quest:280:details:0: Earlier today I spotted some Dark Iron Insurgents swimming toward the Dam with a large keg. No Mountaineers were on hand to stop them! I'm afraid they've planted the Seaforium at the base of the Dam and it could blow at any minute! Let me combine all these ingredients into the ⟦E5⟧. There we go.
rows.quest:280:details:1: Now I need you to take this mixture and stir it into the keg before it's too late! Hurry!
rows.quest:280:progress:0: The top of the keg slowly twists off.
rows.quest:280:completion:0: The keg fizzles slightly as the ⟦E5⟧ settles in.
rows.quest:297:details:0: Recently, just before the Troggs surfaced within the site, we had uncovered a large number of strange, carved idols. But we didn't have the chance to study them, for soon after their discovery the Troggs chased us away from the ruins! And those idols have a strange effect on the Troggs. It makes them go berserk!
rows.quest:297:details:1: Bring me 8 idols - I want to study them, and I want them out of Trogg hands! You can find the idols on the Troggs infesting the site.
rows.quest:297:progress:0: Do you have those Idols? We must study them and report our findings to ⟦E10⟧!
rows.quest:297:completion:1: And you don't look too worse for wear, even with those berserk Troggs about. I'm going to keep my eye on you...you show some promise.
rows.quest:436:details:0: ⟦E11⟧ is heading an excavation of ancient ruins east of the lake. His progress has been slow lately, especially considering all the supplies we've sent him.
rows.quest:436:details:1: ⟦E12⟧'s a stout, honest dwarf who values results, which has me worried that forces are at work against him.
rows.quest:436:details:2: Go to ⟦E13⟧ and speak with ⟦E6⟧. He manages the details of the site and will know why there's a slowdown.
rows.quest:436:details:3: To get to the excavation site, go around the southern tip of the lake, then head east.
rows.quest:436:completion:0: Jern wants to know what the slowdown is, eh?
rows.quest:436:completion:1: ⟦E12⟧ is putting together his latest progress report with details, but I can tell you this:
rows.quest:86613:title: ⟦E14⟧
rows.quest:255:obj:0: ⟦E15⟧ of Thelsamar has hired you to kill 4 Mo'grosh Ogres, 4 Mo'grosh Brutes and 4 Mo'grosh Enforcers.
rows.quest:255:details:0: Two months just to hear from ⟦E10⟧ that we'll be spared a handful of soldiers for our own defense, and another two months until they arrive! Bad enough that our town goes unprotected, but the excavation and the dam--the dam!--are open to attacks as well.
rows.quest:255:details:1: I've no choice then, it seems. I'll need hired arms.
rows.quest:255:details:2: How about you? You seem a likely sort, ⟦4⟧. A group of ogres has set up camp on the northeast of the lake. Perhaps you will be the one to remove the threat to our town?
rows.quest:255:completion:0: Ah, this is excellent news! Your efforts are greatly appreciated by myself and the people of Thelsamar. Better yet, if we can solve the ogre problem, we'll be able to shift our focus to those Light-burning troggs.
rows.quest:271:obj:0: Kill ⟦E17⟧ then show your handiwork to ⟦E18⟧ at the Farstrider Lodge.
rows.quest:271:details:0: I don't suppose you'd be interested in a little payback for His Boldness? Daryl does have some skill, it pains me to say.
rows.quest:271:details:1: BA year ago, a large bear had been the target of the Farstrider Lodge, but none of the hunters had any luck with him. So, Daryl thought he'd try his hand against him. All he had to show for his effort was that ugly scar over his eye.
rows.quest:271:details:2: Kill the bear, and I'm sure even Daryl would be speechless for once.
rows.quest:271:details:3: The bear, ⟦E17⟧, can be found around his lair in the hills over Thelsamar.
rows.quest:271:progress:0: Ah, ⟦5⟧! Back so soon? No doubt you've been at the hunt again? Don't worry if you've had some setbacks, in the long run it will make you better!⟦6⟧⟦7⟧... You couldn't get much worse, anyway...
rows.quest:271:completion:0: Er... what's this? A bear's head, by the looks at it.
rows.quest:271:completion:1: B<He runs a finger along his scar unconsciously.>
rows.quest:271:completion:2: Well, that's quite an interesting kill you have yourself there. Couldn't be that bear from back then...
rows.quest:271:completion:3: B<He trails off then starts to visibly shake.>
rows.quest:271:completion:4: Oh, take that away take it away! Get that grisly thing out of here!
rows.quest:283:obj:0: The ⟦E5⟧ seemed to take effect. Return to Chief Engineer Hinderweir to report the good news.
rows.quest:283:completion:0: Thank you so much, ⟦8⟧!! You have saved the Stonewrought Dam! Without your help, the Dark Iron terrorists would have surely seen to this mighty landmark's demise. You have made the Kingdom and the ⟦E21⟧ proud, brave ⟦9⟧.
rows.quest:283:completion:1: The Dam is once again safe. . . for the time being at least. . . .
rows.quest:531:obj:0: Bring ⟦E17⟧'s head to ⟦E22⟧ at the Farstrider Lodge.
rows.quest:531:details:0: Light! Don't bring things like that into the Lodge... it's unsanitary, unspeakable, un... un... unsanitary!
rows.quest:531:details:1: Just get it out of here, will you? No one wants to see your bloody little trophy, really!
rows.quest:531:progress:0: Great job, ⟦10⟧! We really showed him! Here, give me the head and I'll take care of it.
rows.quest:531:completion:0: Thanks for helping me out with my little plan, ⟦11⟧. I've been itching for months to get back at that snooty, stuck-up boy, and I'd say we did a pretty good job! Here, have this, you've earned it.
rows.quest:256:obj:0: Kill ⟦E23⟧ and bring his head to ⟦E15⟧ of Thelsamar.
rows.quest:256:details:0: By order of the Magistrate of Thelsamar:
rows.quest:256:details:1: ⟦E23⟧, the ogre presumed to be the leader and coordinator of attacks against the town of Thelsamar, Stonewrought Dam, and the excavation site, is wanted dead through any means necessary.
rows.quest:256:details:2: Monetary compensation will be provided when proof is brought to the Magistrate of ⟦E23⟧'s death.
rows.quest:256:details:3: ⟦E23⟧ was last seen at the ogre encampment in the northeastern part of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:256:progress:0: Yes? Is there something I can do for you?
rows.quest:256:completion:0: Yech! What is that thing? And why would you bring it...
rows.quest:256:completion:1: Bloody--! Is it? Well, Light burn me, is that the head of that bloody ogre? This certainly is a catch then! Here, your reward and the thanks of myself and the people of Thelsamar.
rows.quest:2500:obj:0: Acquire the reagents ⟦E24⟧ needs from the ⟦E25⟧, then return to him in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:2500:details:0: ⟦12⟧, I would make use of your services. I am an alchemist of some note, and I seek your aid in acquiring some reagents found out in the ⟦E25⟧.
rows.quest:2500:details:1: I need the following items to replenish my stocks: five buzzard gizzards, ten crag coyote fangs, and five rock elemental shards. Obviously, you can get them off of the beasties themselves; if you're not the fighting type, then find friends who are.
rows.quest:2500:details:2: Acquire these items for me, you'll get some coin out of the deal.
rows.quest:2500:progress:0: Have you gotten the things I need yet?  You won't get paid unless you bring me those reagents.
rows.quest:2500:completion:0: Ah, well done ⟦13⟧. These should last me for a little while at least. Here is your pay, as promised.
rows.quest:2500:completion:1: If you're interested, I have some more reagents I could use. These, however, are only found in the depths of the ⟦E26⟧ excavation. They will not be easy to get, but I will make it worth your while if you are interested in helping me again.
rows.quest:2500:completion:2: Perhaps something more than some shiny coins, yes?
rows.quest:2501:obj:0: Use the empty thaumaturgy vessels on scorched guardian dragons found in the ⟦E25⟧. Once you have them filled, bring them to ⟦E24⟧ in Thelsamar.
rows.quest:2501:details:0: You have been most helpful to me, ⟦14⟧. I would like to reward you with the very recipe for the brew I gave you earlier, but I must ask of you a favor that is quite dangerous.
rows.quest:2501:details:1: This lockbox contains three empty thaumaturgy vessels; they are imbued with an attunement aura that will drain the blood of a scorched guardian dragon. Using one on the beast will anger it greatly, so be careful. Once you have all three filled, bring them to me.
rows.quest:2501:details:2: Do this, and the recipe will be yours.
rows.quest:2501:progress:0: Have you used the vessels to get me the scorched guardian dragon blood I need?  Yes, I know it is a dangerous task... but the recipe for my restorative brew awaits your success.  Risk and reward, my friend... risk and reward...
rows.quest:2501:completion:0: From one alchemist to another, I salute you. Here, take this recipe and commit it to your knowledge. May it bring you the success and rewards that it has brought me over the years!
rows.quest:3182:details:0: You expect me to believe a story like that? The real horn would have had my broken axe head still lodged into its surface.
rows.quest:3182:details:1: Listen, take that obvious fake to ⟦E30⟧ in ⟦E10⟧. If he can validate your claim, you will receive a proof of deed. Bring that proof back to me and I'll give you the key to the ⟦E31⟧.
rows.quest:3182:progress:0: Why hello there young lady. Would you like a tour of the museum?
rows.quest:3182:completion:1: Oh my, I don't believe it! Do you realize what you've got here, ⟦15⟧? This is the horn of Margol the Rager! Margol, the bane of every archaeologist that ever set foot in the ⟦E31⟧.
